title: IEEE Program Schools Preuniversity Educators On Tech Topics
caption:
Professional engineers are bringing teachers behind the scenes of high-tech manufacturing. These educators are getting hands-on experience to help prepare the next generation for future careers in STEM.

Source: Spectrum - IEEE Program Schools Preuniversity Educators On Tech Topics
